不播放动画，画一个面积同为 12 平方单位、形状不同的矩形。说明每行格数、行数和: Without playing the animation, draw a differently shaped rectangle with an area of 12 square units. Explain the relationship between row length, number of rows, and total squares.
旋转角的一条边，让开口、刻度与角度数值同步变化。支持拖动与键盘滑杆。: Rotate one arm of an angle while its opening, scale, and numerical value change together. Supports dragging and keyboard sliders.
